entities.title: Hook policy, init and report
entities.summary: The hook blocks what it should and lets the rest through, init merges safely and idempotently, and report aggregates the log.
criteria: grep, rg in a pipeline, git grep, find, cat on a file, sed -n on a file, xargs grep and the Grep and Glob tools are blocked
dotnet build, git log, a heredoc to a file, echo grep, sed -i, tail -f, find -exec, # allow-raw commands and other tools are allowed
the built-in Read is blocked for .cs files in any letter case and allowed for other files or no path, and its message names zazzle read
blocked commands point at zazzle_find, zazzle_ls and zazzle_read, and C# declarations at zazzle_find_symbol, never at the indexer's removed tools

init merges into existing settings, is idempotent and keeps unrelated keys; it registers the zazzle server, its permission and enabled server, and the Bash|Grep|Glob|Read matcher, and removes the indexer's server, permission and enabled server left by an earlier init
without zazzled, init writes no MCP server at all and says zazzled was not found
zazzled beside the indexer is found, and a directory that does not exist is never returned (the PATH lookup itself is not checked)
report aggregates tools, resolution paths, hook blocks and gap notes, also from records of tools since removed, and leaves out search selectivity and run commands
